caption: The drawing depicts a human figure standing on a small, irregularly shaped brown platform. The figure is dressed in a long, yellow robe with purple trim at the collar, cuffs, and hem, as well as green inner sleeves visible at the wrists. The yellow robe features embroidered designs, including a pink and white flower on the left sleeve and two white animal motifs near the lower front. The figure wears layered green garments underneath the robe, with vertical patterns of orange and purple on the front panel. The person is holding an object resembling a fan or paddle in the right hand, which is vertically positioned. The figure’s face is smooth and expressionless with minimal makeup, and the hair is black, parted in the middle, and pulled back, adorned with a red accessory or flower on the left side. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Tea Importer's Sign
